engine_anomaly_prob.role: the verdict a disagreement head would second-guess -- the decisive baseline; a head that separates worse than this cannot help

consequential.reason: measured no gain: learned test AUC 0.8007 does not beat the strongest baseline by the 0.02 margin (engine anomaly_prob 0.9608, phi-reference head 0.8454, mean detector score 0.8163). The engine's own fusion of the detector scores already dominates any re-weighting of them, so a disagreement head separating worse than the verdict it second-guesses would demote net-correct verdicts

decision: SHIPPED (observability-only) - consequential role REFUSED: measured no gain: learned test AUC 0.8007 does not beat the strongest baseline by the 0.02 margin (engine anomaly_prob 0.9608, phi-reference head 0.8454, mean detector score 0.8163). The engine's own fusion of the detector scores already dominates any re-weighting of them, so a disagreement head separating worse than the verdict it second-guesses would demote net-correct verdicts. The existing reconstruction-gated checkpoint keeps serving observability only; no detection head ships and the decision layer's GOSNN overlay stays structurally inert.

diagnostics.note: linear probe on the raw padded detector-score member; diagnostic upper bound for simple re-weighting of the detector scores -- never a gate input

bootstrap.design: dataset-stratified paired bootstrap of AUC_learned - max(AUC_engine_prob, AUC_phi_head, AUC_mean_score) on the test split; ship requires the 5th percentile > 0

gate.constraint: held-out detection AUC (mean per-dataset) must beat the engine's OWN anomaly_prob (the verdict the overlay would second-guess) AND the phi-reference-fusion head AND the mean detector score by the margin with bootstrap support; fused std >= floor x member std; the demotion rule needs validation-viable thresholds and must fire on test, be enriched in wrong verdicts (enrichment > 1), and retain >= floor of correct verdicts

harvest.sampling: label-stratified rows from the held-out TEST+VALIDATION splits (positives up to half each dataset's budget); AUC is prevalence-invariant over independent single-row calls, so stratification tightens variance without bias
